OrganoTex Garment Care Kit (300 ml).descriptionEn:
BioCare Sport Textile Wash
Gentle detergent for functional clothing and shell garments with membranes (e.g. Dryvr/Interface, as rain and wind clothing. Also for outdoor clothing, parkas, fleece, and textile outdoor gear. Maintains the fabric’s water repellent finish (DWR) longer, and leaves no residue that impairs the garment’s breathability. It also works in cold water, making it perfect for hiking trips. Preferable used before reproofing with OrganoTex waterproofing products.

Wash-In Textile Waterproofing Textile waterproofing that is easily washed into the garment in a washing machine to restore or improve water and dirt-repellency. Suitable for sports and outdoor garments made from polyester, polyamide, wool, down, or blends. Compatible with microporous membranes like Dyrvr. Maintains the garment’s breathability, color, and feel.

Sustainability
The product is based on nature’s own chemistry. It is 100% biobased, readily biodegradable*, and PFAS-free. Eco-labeled with OEKO-TEX ECO PASSSPORT and USDA Certified Biobased Product 100%. *according to OECD 301F

 

 
How to use BioCare Sport Textile Wash
1) Shake the bottle and make sure the detergent compartment is clean.
2) Add 30 ml (soft water) or 40 ml (hard water) into the detergent compartment for up to 3 garments or 4–5 kg laundry. Do not use fabric softener.
3) Wash and dry according to care instructions. 
Handwash: 20 ml/10 L water. Also efficient in cold water.

How to use Wash-In Textile Waterproofing
1) Wash and rinse the garment(s) without softener. It is recommended to use a detergent suitable for functional garments, for example OrganoTex BioCare Sport Textile Wash. Keep clothing inside the washing machine. 
2) Dose to a clean detergent compartment: 1 item = 100 ml, 2 items = 150 ml, 3 items (max) 200 ml. Run a short wash and rinse program (follow care instructions). 
3) For best result, dry on low heat (follow care instructions). Or let air-dry for at least 24 hours.

We believe that young golfers also deserve premium, high-tech golf clothing, which is why we’ve created a kids’ golf rain jacket that has all of the features of the adult version. Robert is a junior full-zip 100% waterproof GORE-TEX Paclite® jacket designed to provide comfort and allow full freedom of movement while playing golf. The GORE-TEX Paclite® range is very lightweight, making it easy to wear, and to carry in your bag.

Rowan - Breathable short sleeve golf shi.descriptionEn:
With a tailored collar and open sleeve ends, the Rowan printed kids polo is a youth version of the men’s Miro shirt (useful if you’re looking for matching father and child golf outfits!) Galvin Green’s VENTIL8™ PLUS shirt range is a collection of smart, performance tops designed by golfers, for golfers.
 

 
The Rowan printed kids polo shirt has a playful all over print with small icons of golf clubs, carts, golfers, and more. Designed for a young golfer but made with the same high-tech, performance details as the adult range, this shirt is made from an extremely breathable, quick dry fabric that offers UV 20+ protection.

Rylan - Breathable short sleeve golf shi.descriptionEn:
With a tailored collar and open sleeve ends, the Rylan classic youth golf polo has similar details to the adult range, but its cut and silhouette are optimized for a young golfer.
 

 
Rylan is a classic youth golf polo from Galvin Green’s VENTIL8™ PLUS range — a collection of high tech, premium golf shirts that are extremely breathable and quick dry. made from a stretch fabric with built in UV factor 20+, this shirt is comfortable and offers protection on sunny days.

Samuel - Cap.descriptionEn: The Samuel baseball cap has a military-inspired silhouette with an all-over micro stripe print. Perforated on both sides for extra breathability, Samuel has a unique, modern adjuster strap at the back.

Sanders - Golf cap.descriptionEn:
The Sanders lightweight cap has an adjustable circumference of 54 to 62 cm (21.3 to 24.4 inches.)
 

 
Sanders is a lightweight cap designed to offer cover and protection while you are playing golf. Available in classic navy or white, this is part of Galvin Green’s headwear range, designed to offer protection in different golf conditions.

Sanford - Lightweight solid golf cap.descriptionEn:
Headwear is an essential accessory on the golf course, so choose yours wisely. Sanford is a lightweight cap made from an extremely breathable, quick dry fabric. Ideal for protection against the sun, or to offer warmth when it’s cold, Sanford is available in a range of seasonal or classic colours.
 

 
This lightweight solid golf cap has a tone on tone logo on the side, and an adjustable circumference of 54 to 62 cm (21.3 to 24.4 inches.)

Scott - Golf cap.descriptionEn:
This breathable golf cap has an adjustable circumference, measuring 54 to 62 cm (21,3 to 24,4 inches).
 

 
Scott is a breathable golf cap that’s made from quick dry fabric, ensuring comfort when you are playing golf on a hot day.

Smith - Bucket hat.descriptionEn: The Smith bucket hat is designed to offer protection from sun, wind, and light rain. Featuring an adjustable drawcord, it stays secure in windy conditions while offering windproof protection and a water‑repellent finish. Extremely breathable with a Warming Effect #1 lining, Smith delivers lightweight comfort and a custom fit through its adjustable width design.

Tate - Slingbag.descriptionEn:
The Tate sling bag has a large main compartment that opens widely, and an inner pocket with a zipper. This is an ingenious and convenient solution when you just need to have the most important things with you on the go.
 

 
Made of a durable and wind and water repellent fabric, this sling bag is ideal for both city and outdoor adventures. A practical, smart and functional small bag that is easy to swing over your shoulder.

Theo - Golf towel.descriptionEn: An essential companion on the golf course, Theo is a tri-fold golf towel perfect for wiping down clubs and balls between holes. The towel features an embroidered Galvin Green logo and the built-in hook allows for quick and easy attachment to your bag.

Tromb - Stormproof golf umbrella.descriptionEn:
Weighing 750 grams, Tromb is an ideal golf umbrella for anyone who needs protection when playing golf in the rain or the sun.
 

 
Tromb is a 60” golf umbrella built with an extra strong frame and designed to protect you in difficult weather conditions. With a double layer top, pressure can be released and air can pass through, allowing the umbrella to have more stability on windy days. With UPF 50+, this golf umbrella also acts as sun protection.

Troy - Insulating golf neck warmer.descriptionEn:
Rated warming effect #1, this lightweight neck warmer provides light thermal insulation. Made from a durable, breathable, easy care fabric, this practical accessory is a favourite on the golf course and during other outdoor activities.
 

 
Troy is a lightweight neck warmer designed to be worn around your neck or around your head. Featuring a digital print and made from a soft, stretchy material, Troy is a practical accessory to have on hand when you risk getting caught out in the cold.

Ward - Elastic golf belt.descriptionEn:
The Ward belt has a flip closure buckle that allows you to easily adjust the belt to your size.
 

 
The Ward belt has a flip closure buckle that allows you to easily adjust the belt to your size.

Will - Elastic golf belt.descriptionEn:
The Will braided stretchy belt is part of Galvin Green’s premium golf accessory range, designed to compliment the mens and women's apparel collections.
 

 
Will is a braided stretchy belt with a webbing strap and metal buckle. Available in three colourways, each with three colours, Will is a perfect compliment to your golf pants or shorts.
